tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

tools.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. The runtime context contains a memory index with ids, kinds, scopes, dates and one-line summaries. Use action "search" or "get" to read topic bodies before answering questions about the user's preferences, the project, or earlier decisions. Use action "save" when the user asks you to remember something or when they state a durable preference, decision, conclusion or reference; use action "update" to correct an existing topic instead of saving a duplicate. Use action "forget" only when the user explicitly asks to delete a memory. Use action "extract" to distill the current session into memory on demand. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Omit `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` to use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

## 9. 响应式与可访问性（F1 横切，2026-11-11 收口）
- >1180px：单侧栏（品牌/导航/会话，288px）+ 对话 + 运行轨迹（280px）三栏；900–1180px：单侧栏 + 对话，运行轨迹改为右侧抽屉；<900px：侧栏与轨迹均变为抽屉，移动端顶栏固定「全局搜索」入口；
- 键盘可达：所有可聚焦控件有焦点环（移除全部 `outline: none`，统一 `:focus-visible`）；发送 `Enter`、换行 `Shift+Enter`、关闭弹层 `Esc`、全局搜索 `Ctrl/Cmd+K`；`AppLayout` 提供「跳到主内容」skip link；
- 颜色对比度 ≥ WCAG AA：`--ink-3` 由 `#606b72` 调整为 `#5a656c`（侧栏 `--paper-2` 上由 4.4 提升到 4.82），工具卡 10px 徽标改用 `--amber-text`；Element Plus 变量用 `html:root` 提高特异性，避免按需 CSS 覆盖主色；
- 状态不只靠颜色表达（配文字/图标）；流式内容不逐字播报，`aria-live="polite"` 区域只播报「开始回复 / 回复完成 / 生成失败 / 等待审批」等状态节点；
- 对话长列表用 `virtua` 的 `VList` 虚拟滚动（动态高度、前置插入锚定、贴底/回到底部），1000 条消息 E2E 验证 DOM 行数 < 60；
- Playwright E2E 内置 axe 扫描（登录、对话空态/消息态、命令面板、审批、知识库、设置、智能体、任务），`critical` / `serious` 违规为 0。

655: + *   SMOKE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1 node scripts/smoke-m9-backend.mjs
656: + *
657: + * 前置：
658: + *   - 后端已启动（默认 127.0.0.1:8000）；
659: + *   - `dev@example.com` 为管理员（scripts/seed_dev_account.py 提权后的开发账号）；
660: + *   - 运行断言依赖 LLM 真实调用工具（检索步骤命中 `search_knowledge` 后发
661: + *     `workflow.step`），LLM key / embedding 不可用时该段会失败。
662: + *
663: + * 原则：
664: + *   - 模板一律带 `[smoke-m9]` 前缀，脚本开头与结尾各清理一次（幂等，不留痕迹）；
665: + *   - 运行产生的会话与 run 不做删除（与既有 smoke 脚本口径一致）；
666: + *   - 不为让脚本变绿而放宽断言语义。
667: + */
668: +
669: +const BASE_URL = (process.env.SMOKE_BASE_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1').replace(/\/$/, '')
670: +const ADMIN_EMAIL = process.env.SMOKE_EMAIL ?? 'dev@example.com'
671: +const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.SMOKE_PASSWORD ?? 'dev-password-123'
672: +const TEMPLATE_PREFIX = '[smoke-m9]'
673: +const STREAM_TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.SMOKE_STREAM_TIMEOUT ?? 90_000)
674: +
675: +let passed = 0
676: +let failed = 0
677: +const failures = []
678: +
679: +function assert(condition, message) {
680: +  if (!condition) throw new Error(message)
681: +  passed += 1
682: +}
683: +
684: +async function api(path, { method = 'GET', token, body } = {}) {
685: +  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, {
686: +    method,
687: +    headers: {
688: +      Accept: 'application/json',
689: +      ...(body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
690: +      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
691: +    },
692: +    // GET 不允许携带 body；oxlint unicorn/no-invalid-fetch-options 会拦截。
693: +    ...(method !== 'GET' && body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
694: +  })
695: +  const text = await response.text()
696: +  let data = null
697: +  try {
698: +    data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null
699: +  } catch {
700: +    data = text
701: +  }
702: +  return { status: response.status, data }
703: +}

714: +/** 三步演示模板：检索 → a2a → 审批（审批步骤强制审批集合）。 */
715: +function threeStepPayload() {

719: +    steps: [

721: +        id: 's1',
722: +        type: 'knowledge_search',
723: +        title: '检索工单规范',
724: +        instruction: '检索本周工单处理规范与复盘文档',
725: +      },
726: +      { id: 's2', type: 'a2a', title: '数据核对', instruction: '交给数据核对智能体核对数字' },
727: +      {
728: +        id: 's3',
729: +        type: 'approval',
730: +        title: '审批发布',
731: +        config: { tools: ['send_message'] },
732: +      },
733: +    ],
734: +  }

737: +/** 按 name 前缀清理脚本自建模板（幂等：开头清残留、结尾清本次）。 */
738: +async function cleanupSmokeTemplates(token) {
739: +  const list = await api('/workflows?limit=100', { token })
740: +  if (list.status !== 200) return
741: +  for (const row of list.data.items ?? []) {
742: +    if (row.scope === 'user' && row.name?.startsWith(TEMPLATE_PREFIX)) {

747: +
748: +/**
749: + * 读一段 SSE 流，直到终态帧或审批挂起后恢复完成。
750: + * 返回 { events, workflowSteps, approvalIds }：events 为事件名序列，
751: + * workflowSteps 为 workflow.step 帧的 data 列表。
752: + */
753: +async function readChatStream(token, payload) {
754: +  const controller = new AbortController()
755: +  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), STREAM_TIMEOUT_MS)
756: +  const events = []
757: +  const workflowSteps = []
758: +  const approvalIds = []
759: +  try {
760: +    const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/chat/stream`, {
761: +      method: 'POST',
762: +      signal: controller.signal,
763: +      headers: {
764: +        Accept: 'text/event-stream',
765: +        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
766: +        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
767: +      },
768: +      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
769: +    })
770: +    assert(response.status === 200, `chat/stream 期望 200，实际 ${response.status}`)
771: +
772: +    let buffer = ''
773: +    let eventName = ''
774: +    let dataLines = []
775: +    const flush = async () => {
776: +      if (!eventName) return
777: +      const data = dataLines.length > 0 ? JSON.parse(dataLines.join('\n')) : {}
778: +      events.push(eventName)
779: +      if (eventName === 'workflow.step') workflowSteps.push(data)
780: +      if (eventName === 'approval.required' && data.approval_id) {
781: +        approvalIds.push(data.approval_id)
782: +        // 审批挂起是非终态：批准后 run.resumed 继续流。
783: +        const decision = await api(`/approvals/${data.approval_id}/decision`, {
784: +          method: 'POST',
785: +          token,
786: +          body: { decision: 'approve', note: 'smoke-m9 自动批准' },
787: +        })
788: +        assert(
789: +          decision.status === 200,
790: +          `审批决策失败：${decision.status} ${JSON.stringify(decision.data)}`,
791: +        )
792: +      }
793: +      eventName = ''
794: +      dataLines = []
795: +    }
796: +
797: +    const reader = response.body.getReader()
798: +    const decoder = new TextDecoder()
799: +    let done = false
800: +    while (!done) {
801: +      const { value, done: streamDone } = await reader.read()
802: +      done = streamDone
803: +      if (value) buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
804: +      let index
805: +      while ((index = buffer.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
806: +        const line = buffer.slice(0, index).replace(/\r$/, '')
807: +        buffer = buffer.slice(index + 1)
808: +        if (line === '') {
809: +          await flush()
810: +        } else if (line.startsWith('event:')) {
811: +          eventName = line.slice(6).trim()
812: +        } else if (line.startsWith('data:')) {
813: +          dataLines.push(line.slice(5).trim())
814: +        }
815: +      }
816: +      if (events.includes('message.done') || events.includes('run.interrupted')) break
817: +    }
818: +  } finally {
819: +    clearTimeout(timer)
820: +  }
821: +  return { events, workflowSteps, approvalIds }
822: +}

关键确认：

1. **后端审批轮确实发 `run.interrupted`**：`app/modules/chat/service.py` Line 1259:「图停在审批 gate：落库部分内容、run→interrupted、发非终态 run.interrupted」，Line 1299 发 "run.interrupted"。且集成测试 test_workflow_execution.py 表明工作流强制审批也是 `run.interrupted` → approve → run succeeded。

   所以 smoke 脚本的 `readChatStream` 的 break 条件 `events.includes('run.interrupted')` 意味着：**如果工作流运行触发审批轮（approval.required → run.interrupted），流读取会在 run.interrupted 处 break，批准虽已发出，但恢复后的 run.resumed / workflow.step(ok) / message.done 帧永远不会被读到**。因此报告 §1.4「审批 approval.required 自动批准后恢复」和 §7.3「覆盖了恢复后帧出现」的声明与脚本实际能力不符——脚本根本无法断言恢复后的帧。这个自动批准逻辑实际上在 run.interrupted break 时审批帧已 flush（approval.required 先于 run.interrupted），批准已发，但之后断流。所以「自动批准」确实发生了，但「恢复后帧出现」断言不到。

   等等——还要确认一件事：主 smoke 运行消息「检索本周工单处理规范，并总结要点」是否触发审批。审批步骤 config.tools = ['send_message']，强制审批集合只拦 send_message 工具。消息不含 send_message 意图，检索步骤用 search_knowledge。所以主运行链路不触发审批，approval.required 不出现，run.interrupted 不出现，break 条件不影响主链路。所以 56 项全绿真实成立。问题只在报告对「审批恢复链路已覆盖」的表述与脚本实际不符（脚本不可能断言恢复后帧，因为 run.interrupted break）。

   这属于「报告/文档准确性」问题——声明了未真正覆盖的覆盖面。判断级别：脚本本身断言语义没有放宽（没有为绿而改断言），主链路真实全绿。报告 §7.3 的疑虑部分其实是诚实承认「未覆盖 reject 分支」，但「覆盖了恢复后帧出现」是错的。重要还是 Minor？这是文档/报告声明与实际能力不符，会影响后续维护者对覆盖面的判断（误以为审批恢复链路有 smoke 断言）。我认为 Minor~Important 之间。考虑校准:「Important = 本任务不可信直到修复」。脚本绿是真实的，主链路断言是真实的。报告声明不实不影响脚本可信度，但影响交付报告（handoff）可信度。而且注意 break-on-run.interrupted 还有一个副作用：若审批真的被触发，脚本会在批准后立即 abort 流——后端 run 继续跑，脚本已结束；不会失败，只是覆盖缺失。加上 clean-up 不删 run（脚本口径如此）。
   
   我判 Minor（文档准确性），但明确指出 break 条件使审批恢复帧在结构上不可断言，报告 §1.4/§7.3 表述需更正。嗯，但等一下——「审批 approval.required 自动批准后恢复」在报告 §1.4 是这样写的：「运行链路（SSE 读流：run.started → workflow.step 五键齐全含检索步骤 → message.done；审批 approval.required 自动批准后恢复）」。这读起来像运行链路中发生了 approval.required 并恢复。而 handoff §3 的证据链没提 approval.required。而主运行消息不会触发审批。所以 §1.4 表述确实不准确——它描述的是 readChatStream 的防御性能力而非实际发生的断言。而 §7.3「覆盖了恢复后帧出现」明确声称覆盖——不实。这在 handoff 交付报告里也有同样表述（§6 已知限制台账说「真实审批中断→恢复→workflow.step(ok/rejected) 链路由后端 T6 保证（smoke:m9 未自动驱动审批轮）」——等等，handoff §6 说「smoke:m9 未自动驱动审批轮」！这与 task-report §7.3「smoke 中是自动批准路径，覆盖了恢复后帧出现」矛盾！handoff 是准确的（「未自动驱动审批轮」），task-report §7.3 不准确。让我再读一遍 handoff §6：「真实『审批中断 → 恢复 → workflow.step(ok/rejected)』链路由后端 T6 保证（smoke:m9 未自动驱动审批轮）」。对，handoff 正确说明 smoke 未驱动审批轮。而 task-report §7.3 说「smoke 中是自动批准路径，覆盖了恢复后帧出现」——矛盾且不准确。这两处口径不一致。report §1.4「审批 approval.required 自动批准后恢复」也是误导性表述。这是报告准确性问题，Minor（因为 handoff 交付报告本身口径正确，task-report 是任务内部报告）。不过「覆盖了恢复后帧出现」若被当成测试覆盖依据就有风险。我给 Minor，但明确指出。

   等一下，还有一种可能性：工作流运行中审批触发时，后端在同一个 SSE 流里发 approval.required → run.interrupted 后保持连接打开（非终态，SSE 保持），批准后同一连接恢复发 run.resumed → ... → message.done。M5 的语义是「run.interrupted（非终态，SSE 保持打开）」。如果连接保持打开，脚本 break 是主动放弃读取（break while 循环然后 finally abort）。所以无论如何恢复后帧不被读取。除非——break 前 approval.required 已经 flush 并批准，run.interrupted 到达 break。确实如此。

   好，这个点定性：smoke 脚本对审批链路的「自动批准」代码路径在 run.interrupted break 下无法完成「恢复后帧」断言；报告声明与实际不符；handoff 口径正确。Minor。

2. **workflow.step 五键**：src/types/workflow.ts 里没有 WorkflowStepData 接口！文件里只有 WorkflowStep/Workflow/WorkflowRun/WORKFLOW_STEP_TYPES/validateWorkflowSteps。报告 §6 自审说「WorkflowStepData 与 workflowsApi 七方法在 T1 定义」——brief 的 Self-Review 也说「Workflow/WorkflowStep/WorkflowRun/WorkflowStepData/WorkflowStepProcess 与 workflowsApi 七方法在 T1 定义」。但 src/types/workflow.ts 里没有 WorkflowStepData！也许 WorkflowStepData 定义在别处（比如 chat types 或 api/workflows.ts 或 stream types）。smoke 断言五键 `step_id/step_type/step_title/tool/status`。我需要找到 WorkflowStepData 的定义来对齐。named risk：smoke 断言的五键是否与 T1 WorkflowStepData 一致。检查：grep WorkflowStepData。

3. **mock db 的生产路径**：grep 显示 mock/db 只被 src/api/mock/__tests__ 和 mock 内部引用。还要确认 src/api 入口如何按 VITE_USE_MOCK 分包。让我 grep "useMock|VITE_USE_MOCK" src/api。

再做两个聚焦检查：grep WorkflowStepData 定义；grep src/api/index.ts 的 mock 分包逻辑。
两个聚焦检查有结果了：后端审批 gate 确实发 `run.interrupted`（`service.py:1299`），这影响 smoke 报告口径的核对。还需补两个具名风险检查：`WorkflowStepData` 五键定义位置（`src/types/workflow.ts` 中没有它），以及 mock 分包的生产隔离。
